Uchi-mata in three phases: kuzushi (pull forward; turn the hikite pinky out to make space, then pull with the elbow), tsukuri (step placement for a smooth turn), kake (lift the leg high with your thigh against their inner thigh). (From the Japanese auto-caption transcript, machine-translated.)

Seoi-nage for taller opponents: draw them forward, drop under, keep the tsurite elbow tight to your body, and relax their grip pressure before entering. (From the transcript.)
